decisions.reason: Maintenance oil remains a recurring-demand accessory that complements the firm's oiled surfaces, though last year's pruning of similar care products raises the risk of consolidation.
Moisture-protection underlay is a standard installation accessory, but the withdrawal of the high-density underlay shows the firm is streamlining this range.
Oak parquet is the heart of the firm's core flooring business and design range, so it is very likely to stay.
